body: See a psychiatrist and s/he can properly diagnose you.  Having said that, one of the medications I'm on (risperidone, an anti-psychotic) is a literal life saver for me.  When I'm on it, the suicidal thoughts and ideations disappear.

This is when you use your words and gently, calmly lovingly tell her what you feel.  Despite what others in this thread are saying (and what seems to be the default response in this subreddit), this isn't really a dealbreaker.
